samples.summary: The `ok: true` but `bytes` missing branch of `runFilesDownload` now routes through `upstreamErrorJson` and is untested
samples.evidence: `runFilesDownload` guards with `if (!res.ok || !res.bytes)` (download.ts:56) and now emits `upstreamErrorJson(res)`. For a successful response with no bytes that yields `{error:{code:'HTTP_ERROR',message:'HTTP 200'}}` — a new message the previous code never produced. The new suite's `files download` case (test/upstream-error.test.ts:435-453) only ever calls `fail(status, data)` with `ok:false`, and the pre-existing packages/cli/test/files-download.test.ts:129-142 only covers `ok:false, status:404`. No test drives `{ok:true,status:200,bytes:undefined}`.
searchedFor: read the new `files download` case in test/upstream-error.test.ts

samples.summary: E2E command tests spy on stdout but never assert nothing was written there on the error path
samples.evidence: `stdoutSpy` is created in beforeEach (line 122) and restored in afterEach, but no test in the `content/export commands` describe asserts on it. A regression where a command printed a partial/empty body to stdout in addition to the stderr envelope (e.g. `runDocsContent` still being invoked) would not be caught: the tests only inspect `console.error` via `emitted()`. The spy gives the appearance of stdout coverage without any.
searchedFor: read all uses of stdoutSpy in packages/cli/test/upstream-error.test.ts

samples.summary: No test that the client-synthesised SESSION_EXPIRED envelope still survives the new structural filter
samples.evidence: `HttpClient.sessionExpiredBody()` (http-client.ts:157-164) synthesises `{error:{code:'SESSION_EXPIRED',message}}` for 401s and returns it as `res.data`; both `forwardUpstreamError` and `upstreamErrorJson` now gate forwarding on `isErrorEnvelope`. The new suite only exercises a `TYPE_MISMATCH` fixture (ENVELOPE, test line 23) and never the 401/session-expired path, so a future tightening of `isErrorEnvelope` that swallowed SESSION_EXPIRED (a documented, actionable code) would go uncaught.
searchedFor: grep SESSION_EXPIRED across packages/cli (src and test)
